lines.text: A static pickup cube that can be collected
this one does not turn. It bobs — sin(t) about the height it started at — and standing still while changing is a transformation too
the same cube with one component swapped out: it spins where the other bobs. Two cubes, one transformation each, and the difference between them is the whole lesson
A pickup cube that moves up and down
Pickup cube that rotates continuously — wraps pick_up_cube.gd and disables internal collision so the player can walk into the pickup area …
The bob crosses the same place with another direction. A release gives it angle and speed, while the projection leaves part of the gesture out. Try two different gestures that leave a similar swing.
lines.note: The release keeps a projected velocity and loses the rest of the gesture. The crossing counter retains a total without retaining the circumstances of each pass.

note_src.quote: It discards the rest of the gesture.

lines.text: Every trajectory is a signal in time; recording it reveals the physics as waveform
Every motion is a signal; recording it in time reveals the wave hidden in movement
lines.note: A recording rule selects what survives. Compare a position kept after a movement threshold with a position kept after a time threshold; neither records everything between appointments.

note_src.quote: Each can reveal something the other misses.

lines.text: Industrial drain pipe network built from modular segments
The table is the zero plane from which all measurement begins

A mark keeps travelling after the bob turns. Time has been given a direction; a coarser record can reach further into the past. At the measured period the sparse marks nearly align, and repetition begins to resemble stillness.

lines.note: sine cannot be read off a circle: it needs an origin, a zero angle and a direction of turn, none of which the circle carries — and the projection that survives costs the radius, discarded to keep the function tractable.

note_src.quote: Sin and cos are not properties of the circle. They are properties of a circle with a chosen frame.

lines.text: Choose a hollow, release the spheres, then change their size. At twelve seconds the count stops. Those still inside have a recorded present and an unmeasured future. What would make that hollow a shelter?
3D space defined by sine waves — walls, floors
lines.note: The corridor constructs its smooth skin from samples. A visible boundary, a collision shape and a planned route give a body different possibilities; mesh cost still needs measurement.

note_src.quote: A surface, a boundary and a route are distinct things in this implementation.

lines.text: A half-turn makes the walls bend together. The x-gap stays at two metres, but a body might need another measure. Cross a visible crest: the surface has offered a route without gaining the power to stop you.

lines.note: interference is only where a marker stands: the map rents a lattice to make the field visible, and its spacing and dimmest lit step fence the commons at a boundary neither source chose and neither can move.

note_src.quote: The lattice of small markers pulses in step with the local phase

lines.text: Keep one sound, change the rule that made it, then listen again. The scope rescales what it shows: a phase disturbance can grow while its orange trace keeps the same height.
Timbre is the harmonic fingerprint of a sound
lines.note: The sliders stack integer multiples of one fundamental. This restricts the available partials to harmonic relations; it does not determine whether a listener calls the result bell-like.

note_src.quote: Real acoustic instruments produce INHARMONIC partials (bells, drums, piano strings have stretched harmonics)

lines.text: Musical tension is not metaphor — intervals exert measurable pull on perception
Two waves meeting don't fight — they add. The pattern they make holds more information than either wave …
Consonance is the degree to which two pitches share the same overtone series
UniversalVRAudioController
A sound catalog is a periodic table of timbres, each defined by its synthesis recipe
Every vowel is a pair of resonant frequencies — the mouth is a tunable resonator
lines.note: a garment cannot supply its own body: this one hangs on nobody, so every sine that runs the hem is a claim about flesh the map has removed — the fold argues, and there is no one inside it.

note_src.quote: the dress floats empty, worn by nobody, mathematics wearing itself

lines.note: 4'33" cannot supply its own content: it borrows the ventilation, the lights and the rig's own hum, so the piece runs only while the infrastructure does — and the panes measuring it keep nothing when it stops.

note_src.quote: it can never reach zero because reaching zero would mean the infrastructure had stopped

lines.note: phasing has no score to fall back on: the room depends on a duration only a visitor can spend and cannot store one, so walking through quickly makes the piece genuinely flatter, with nothing kept to prove otherwise.

note_src.quote: punishes impatient traversal with a flatter experience

lines.note: a curve you climb must be cut into treads a foot can hold: eighty steps, none shallower than a stride, so the sine is quantised by the body and its smooth stretches are exactly the ones no climber reaches.

note_src.quote: Each step is a sample; the tread is the period; the rise is the amplitude.

lines.text: When two nearly identical things interfere, their tiny difference becomes the loudest …
lines.note: the lanes are computed a few steps ahead of the foot and never further: the map depends on a horizon it makes as you approach, so it can hand you the sin-cos offset but never the whole curve.

note_src.quote: The path generates itself a few steps ahead of the walker, so the learner always sees a short runway of coming terrain.

lines.text: a sine wave is not invented — it is the inevitable shadow of constant rotation

pearls.edge: resonance needs a rhythm the learner does not own: the creature keeps its own frequency and will not meet you halfway, so the chamber can measure a match but never produce one — most of the encounter is beating.

edge_src.quote: resonance is a narrow condition and the learner has to tune the catalyst slowly to approach it

lines.text: DNA is a double wave frozen in molecular form — information stored as a helix
Every flowing line is a parametric curve — a point moving through space according to …
Any periodic function is a sum of sines; complexity is superposition of simplicity
Multi-mode oscilloscope with VR sliders. Shows waveform
lines.note: a square is an infinite sum and the bench has sixteen sliders, the scope three: the lab borrows a basis it did not pick and must cut the series somewhere — the ripple on the trace is the cut.

note_src.quote: "composite" sums sin(f) + sin(3f)/2 + sin(5f)/3 (the textbook square-wave Fourier series, truncated)

lines.text: A worm moves by passing a sine wave through its body
a microscope is the architectural form of LOOKING-CLOSER
